Point and raster fixtures are deterministic authored examples, MIT, matching the project license. QFIT, SBET and CSD have no RGB field and preview survey geometry. DICOM inputs are synthetic secondary captures with no real patient data. slpk-autzen.slpk is unchanged Esri LEPCC testData/SMALL_AUTZEN_LAS_All.slpk. slpk-colored-autzen.slpk reuses its unchanged XYZ geometry in an authored I3S package with authored RGB bands. These Esri geometry bytes retain Apache-2.0 provenance; see ESRI-LICENSE.txt and ESRI-NOTICE.txt. Source: https://github.com/Esri/lepcc
